json.evidence: Photos 1-4 show the gas meter and regulator on the siding. Photos 6-10 show the AC condenser, a small gray AC disconnect box, and its conduit/whips. Photo 11 shows one electric meter on the siding. Photos 12-15 show the siding, foundation and stones. Photo 16 shows a deck. No photo shows an electrical panel, main breaker, or open panel interior.
json.notes: Only one electric meter is visible, and no panels are pictured, so the panel layout cannot be determined. The AC disconnect is equipment-level, not a main. Multiple mains are not proven, but a single main is not proven either.
